subject: credit-afford-03@3.2.0

requirements.statement: The system shall never decline an application without analyst review.
Approval-rate ratio between age bands shall stay at or above 0.8.
Each score shall come with the top reason codes shown to the analyst.

architecture_summary: Batch-scored gradient-boosted model behind the loan origination system; scores and reason codes are written to the application record. Diagram: https://docs.example.org/credit-afford-03/architecture

model_selection.tradeoffs: Beats the scorecard on held-out data; monotonic constraints and reason codes keep it explainable; the neural network gave no gain worth the opacity.

intervention_points: analyst can override the score with a reason
human_oversight_design.reviewer_context: Score, top five reason codes, and the applicant data the score used.

known_limitations: Not validated for self-employed applicants with under 12 months of history.

reviews.conditions: DPIA approved before training on 2025 data.
